title: Concept: Dagster UI is reachable without authentication
description: The asset graph is the data model of the platform, and the run logs name the storage layers and the code locations. The UI also launches runs, so a public webserver is both a map and a control surface.
applicability: Responses from a Dagster webserver on a reachable host.
risk: The caller reads the data model and run logs, and can launch jobs that write to the storage the assets point at.
